item.text: {"explanation":"Build the sorted weighted slot cycle on each step. State stores tenant FIFO queues, a global pending-ID map, and the next cursor. Adds reject any own pending-ID entry; dispatch scans at most one cycle, removes the first available FIFO item, and advances to the slot after the chosen slot. Output queues are copied so the returned output is a snapshot.","program":"function solve(a){var w=a.config.weights,ts=Object.keys(w).sort(),s=a.state,q,p,c,sl=[],i,j;if(s===null){q={};p={};c=0;for(i=0;i<ts.length;i++)q[ts[i]]=[]}else{q=s.q;p=s.p;c=s.c}for(i=0;i<ts.length;i++)for(j=0;j<w[ts[i]];j++)sl.push(ts[i]);var e=a.event,st='empty',sent=null;if(e.type==='add'){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(p,e.id))st='duplicate';else{q[e.tenant].push(e.id);p[e.id]=e.tenant;st='queued'}}else if(e.type==='dispatch'){for(j=0;j<sl.length;j++){var x=(c+j)%sl.length,t=sl[x];if(q[t].length){sent=q[t].shift();delete p[sent];c=(x+1)%sl.length;st='sent';break}}}var z={};for(i=0;i<ts.length;i++)z[ts[i]]=q[ts[i]].slice();return{state:{q:q,p:p,c:c},output:{status:st,sent:sent,queues:z,cursor:c}}}"}
